recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有數顆小至中型淋巴球，染色質凝集，細胞質中等量淡藍，其中一顆細胞邊緣有細小不規則突起（可能為極性絨毛），並可見紅血球內有 Howell-Jolly 小體；配合臨床，這是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（splenic marginal zone lymphoma）的白血病期表現。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed, clumped chromatin
Moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm; one cell with subtle irregular, short cytoplasmic projections
Two normal segmented neutrophils and scattered platelets
Red cells with Howell-Jolly bodies in the lower left, suggesting hyposplenism or prior splenectomy
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm; one cell shows subtle short irregular cytoplasmic projections, although classic polar villi are not clearly demonstrated. Segmented neutrophils and platelets appear normal, and a few red cells contain Howell-Jolly bodies, raising the possibility of hyposplenism or prior splenectomy. The morphology is not specific on its own. In conjunction with splenomegaly and flow cytometry showing a CD5-/CD10-/CD103- light chain-restricted B-cell population, findings are consistent with leukemic splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and bean-shaped nuclei, with CD103/CD25/CD11c positivity, annexin A1, and BRAF V600E.
CLL cells have scant cytoplasm, soccer-ball chromatin, and smudge cells, and co-express CD5 and CD23.
Cells often have irregular nuclear contours and are CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
Shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation.
